name: Hazardous Chemical Selection and Decision Support
definition: Select, rank, compare, or identify chemicals for a harmful objective. Production belongs to HC3.

name: Precursor, Reagent and Material Acquisition or Substitution
definition: Identify, source, replace, or adapt chemical inputs for a harmful process. Complete synthesis belongs to HC3.

name: Hazardous Synthesis and Production
definition: Produce, synthesize, generate, or manufacture a hazardous substance.

name: Purification, Isolation and Concentration
definition: Recover, separate, purify, enrich, isolate, or concentrate a hazardous substance.

name: Process Optimization, Troubleshooting and Scale-Up
definition: Improve yield, reliability, throughput, scale, or diagnose failures in a harmful chemical process.

name: Harmful Property Enhancement and Formulation
definition: Modify a compound or formulation to intensify misuse-relevant properties. Process changes belong to HC5.

name: Exposure, Delivery and Harmful Application
definition: Deliver, disperse, administer, release, or apply a hazardous chemical to a person or target.

name: Detection, Monitoring and Forensic Evasion
definition: Avoid chemical screening, monitoring, detection, residue analysis, attribution, or forensic reconstruction.

name: Chemical Contamination and Sabotage
definition: Use chemistry to contaminate, damage, disable, or compromise environmental, product, industrial, or infrastructure systems.
